title: Canonical ambient and integral scalar shift comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a Noetherian scheme $T$ of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible, and finite coefficient fields $E\subseteq F\subset\Omega$. Use the ambient completed-coefficient scalar extension of [def-weil-pbc-finite-completed-coefficient-map], its integral bounded constructible complete full subcategory of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and the fixed integer shifts of [def-per-common-stage-shift-structures]. Define the scalar-restriction shift comparison by the degreewise restriction functor on complexes. Define the ambient scalar-extension shift comparison as its left-adjoint mate under derived scalar extension and restriction. Define the shift comparison on the integral scalar-extension restriction by lifting the ambient comparison through the fully faithful integral inclusion; its composite with that inclusion is the ambient comparison. These are the existing normalized data, with independent scheme and algebraic-closure universes.
